notes.text:
HISTORY AND PHYSICAL. Patient seen and examined at bedside. 87-year-old male admitted for community-acquired pneumonia. Admission data:
Day 0: labs bilirubin 0.63, bnp 1146, creatinine 0.99, hemoglobin 14.3, platelets 270, sodium 141, wbc 7.6; vitals dbp 76-81, heart_rate 74-78, map 90-95, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 13-15, sbp 115-122, spo2 96-97, temp 36.5-36.7
Day 0 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV; Chest x-ray: pulmonary vascular congestion, small bilateral effusions; Chest x-ray: right lower lobe opacity; Furosemide 40 mg IV; Transthoracic echo: LVEF 31%, global hypokinesis
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia. CHF.

PROGRESS NOTE, hospital day 1. Patient seen and examined at bedside. Data:
Day 1: labs creatinine 1, hemoglobin 14.3, platelets 268, sodium 140, wbc 7.5; vitals dbp 76-81, heart_rate 74-80, map 89-94, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 14-15, sbp 115-119, spo2 96-97, temp 36.5-36.7
Day 1 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV; Furosemide 40 mg IV
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia. CHF. Continue current management.

DISCHARGE SUMMARY. 87-year-old male, length of stay 5 days. Hospital course: treated per the plan above with daily labs and vital signs; stable for discharge. Medications reconciled and return precautions reviewed. Discharge diagnoses: Community-acquired pneumonia. CHF. Follow up with primary care in one week. Patient seen and examined at bedside.
